trustedContext.tenant: every command/query tenantId is positive and equals TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId
trustedContext.actor: closeMigrationIssue resolverUserId is a positive trusted server-side subject
forbidden: legacy datasource in normal production beans
test fixture as production migration evidence

batch.lineage: previousBatchId and previousIssueId are nullable positive references; remigration after issue closure requires previousIssueId
transitions: markStagedReady READY: IMPORTING -> STAGED_READY when manifest and frozen sources match
markStagedReady FAIL_IMPORT: IMPORTING -> FAILED for a closed importFailureCode
batch.failureRollback: claim and all reconciliation writes join the caller transaction; any failure before completion rolls back to STAGED_READY
batch.completionInvariant: sourceCount = mappedCount + issueCount + retainedCount and every source has exactly one final classification
batch.countUnit: mappedCount, issueCount and retainedCount count unique source records; one MAPPED source may have multiple targets and one ISSUE source may have multiple issue rows

sourceRecord.batchIdentityGuard: after locking tenantId+batchId, command sourceSystem and sourceTable must exactly equal the batch identity; mismatch is BATCH_SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
sourceRecord.replay: same identity and identical immutable fields returns the existing record; any difference is SOURCE_RECORD_CONFLICT
sourceRecord.query: pageSourceRecords reads only the frozen batch by sourceRecordId ASC with afterSourceRecordId exclusive and limit 1..500

reconciliationOwnership.lookup: appendExternalMapping and appendMigrationIssue lock by trusted tenantId+batchId+sourceRecordId
reconciliationOwnership.required: the source record belongs to that tenant and batch, is frozen, and the batch is RECONCILING
reconciliationOwnership.tenantVisibility: cross-tenant batch/source is not visible and returns BATCH_NOT_FOUND or SOURCE_NOT_FOUND
reconciliationOwnership.sourceMismatch: missing source or a sourceRecordId belonging to another batch returns SOURCE_NOT_FOUND
reconciliationOwnership.stateMismatch: a visible batch outside RECONCILING returns BATCH_STATE_CONFLICT

actions.createImportBatch: idempotency key plus canonical command digest; same payload replays the batch, different payload conflicts
actions.appendSourceRecord: intrinsic source identity replay; source payload remains opaque valid JSON and is never reinterpreted by PLT

markStagedReady.READY: requires manifestRowCount, manifestSchemaVersion and manifestContentSha256; forbids failureCode; validates and freezes the source set
markStagedReady.FAIL_IMPORT: forbids successful manifest fields; requires one closed importFailureCode; atomically records FAILED
markStagedReady.retryableFailure: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE and other transient infrastructure failures do not transition the batch and must retry the same intent
markStagedReady.idempotency: same key and same normalized decision payload replays the result; same key and different payload is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

actions.claimStagedBatch: requires caller transaction and claims at most one matching STAGED_READY batch; no match returns claimed=false with no side effects; successful CAS returns the authoritative RECONCILING batch version
actions.pageSourceRecords: read-only cursor query; not one of the eight write actions

appendExternalMapping.RETAINED: targets empty; records an explicit retained result against the stable sourceRecordId

actions.appendMigrationIssue: appends one deterministic OPEN issue against a stable frozen sourceRecordId; does not modify source payload
actions.reconciliationAppendVersionRule: appendExternalMapping and appendMigrationIssue never update batch.version or final batch counts
actions.completeReconciliation: expectedBatchVersion is exactly the version returned by claim; recomputes classifications and counts under lock, then performs one CAS that writes immutable final counts and COMPLETED
actions.closeMigrationIssue: COMPLETED batch and OPEN issue only; CAS appends resolver, ruleVersion, targetResult and audit without changing batch counts

idempotency.appendSourceRecord: uses the intrinsic source identity and immutable payload comparison; correlationId is required and no second idempotency key is introduced
idempotency.claimStagedBatch: uses caller transaction plus locked STAGED_READY CAS; correlationId is required and replay is the enclosing reconciliation transaction responsibility

issueClosure.allowedFrom: OPEN issue whose batch is COMPLETED
issueClosure.effect: fill previously-null resolution fields and append operation audit only
issueClosure.remigration: create a new batch referencing the prior issueId

implementationBoundary.contractGate: API, DTO, stable exception, SDS and machine contract only
implementationBoundary.providerGate: tables, DDL, DO, Mapper XML, Service and MySQL evidence only after this contract passes
